titulo: The first general-purpose computer weighed 27 tons 🏭
descripcion: ENIAC (1945) filled a room, used about 17,500 vacuum tubes and drew around 150 kilowatts of power.

escenas.texto: In nineteen forty five, one computer weighed about twenty seven tons.
It used around seventeen thousand five hundred vacuum tubes.
And it drew about one hundred fifty kilowatts of power.
Today, a chip smaller than your fingernail is millions of times faster.
Programming it meant rewiring cables by hand.
A whole room, to do what your watch does without trying. Follow for more tech history.
